article.description: — Collin Chandler scored a season-high 20 points with four assists, Jaxon Kohler added 16 points on 7-of-11 shooting and No. 21 BYU cruised to a 98-54 win Wednesday night over Northern Colorado.

article.story: PROVO, Utah -- — Collin Chandler scored a season-high 20 points with four assists, Jaxon Kohler added 16 points on 7-of-11 shooting and No. 21 BYU cruised to a 98-54 win Wednesday night over Northern Colorado. Freshman Bruce Branch III also had 16 points to go with a career-high six assists and three steals for BYU (5-0). Brooks Bahr added 13 points, on 6-of-6 shooting, and five steals and Tyler Betsey scored 10. Jake Wahlin scored seven of his nine points on 3-of-4 shooting in the first half, and Kohler had nine points as the Cougars used first-half runs of 13-0 and 15-2 to take a 45-27 halftime lead. Wahlin, a Clemson tranfer, made first start for BYU in place of Robert Wright III (rest). Wright, a junior point guard, leads the team in scoring (24.3 per game), assists (4.8), steals (1.8) and minutes (30.3) this season. Chandler scored or assisted on three straight possessions, including a dunk and an alley-oop to Khadim Mboup, as the Cougars opened the second half on a 26-7 run. The Cougars scored 38 points off 24 Norther Colorado turnovers and outrebounded the Bears 45-21. Manning Shareef scored 11 points to lead Northern Colorado (2-3), and Andrew Crawford added nine points and six rebounds. Up next Northern Colorado: Hosts National Christian College Athletic Association-member Justice University on Saturday. BYU: Plays Washington at the Maui Invitational on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
